_comment: Site file of the real robot. Copy to configs/real/robot.json (git-ignored) and replace every <...> value; keys starting with _ are notes. Read by forceharness/real/config.py (load_robot_config); $FH_ROBOT_CONFIG or --robot-config can point to another file. See docs/real_robot.md.

robot_pc._comment: The real-time computer that runs Polymetis (robot server and gripper server) and, started over SSH per episode, the robot-side worker.
robot_pc._ssh_host_note: Host name or alias from ~/.ssh/config with key-based login (BatchMode is used, so a password prompt fails).
robot_pc._conda_prefix_note: Root of the Python 3.8 environment with polymetis, torchcontrol and torch; exported as CONDA_PREFIX, which Polymetis reads on import. A leading ~/ means the remote home.
robot_pc._hardware_config_note: Polymetis robot-client configuration whose executable_cfg.limits joint limits the worker intersects with its own.
robot_pc._deploy_dir_note: Folder on the robot PC that holds the content-addressed bundles (scripts/real/deploy_robot_side.py --deploy creates it).
robot_pc._urdf_note: Panda URDF for the offline self-test only; null = the one that ships with Polymetis (or $FH_URDF on the robot PC).

gripper._comment: Franka Hand through the Polymetis gripper server. Changed for the public release; not yet validated on hardware.

cameras._comment: RealSense cameras on the workstation: wrist D405 (RGB-D, used for all measurements) and exterior D435 (RGB only).
cameras._hand_eye_file_note: 4x4 T_flange_camera of the wrist camera; relative paths are relative to the repository root. configs/real/hand_eye.example.txt shows the format.
cameras._python_note: Interpreter that runs the capture process and has pyrealsense2; null = the interpreter running the runner.
